value.reply: Here's what I found near Springfield for Mia and Leo. Mia is 4, so the swim lessons for ages 3-5 fit her, and Leo can come along to the storytime and the drop-in playgroup. What should I call you?
groupLeads: Swim lessons at the community pool for ages 3-5, Saturdays at 10:00. Mia fits this group.
Library storytime, Tuesdays at 10:30, free, open to all ages, so Leo can come too. Also a drop-in playgroup for ages 0-6 on weekday mornings, free.
